aria: Animated recap of the Lakers' 124 to 118 home win over Portland: Luka Dončić's jumper in the lane with 28 seconds left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 53 points, the top scorers, how the Lakers won, and the next game at Detroit.
notes: Box score from the Lakers' 124–118 home win over the Portland Trail Blazers on Nov 6, 2026, from the league's stats feed and StatMuse's full box score, with game details from the AP (via CBS Sports), Yahoo Sports, The Sporting Tribune and theScore. All 124 points are accounted for: the feed left out Quentin Grimes (2), which StatMuse lists. The Pistons' record and the Lakers' conference standing are from the same feed.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Luka Dončić's jumper in the lane with 28 seconds left (the AP's description; Yahoo Sports puts it at 27.7 seconds), which put the Lakers up six after Damian Lillard's free throws had cut it to four. The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as a plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Los Angeles Lakers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Dončić’s listed 6-foot-8 and 230 pounds, with arms scaled to his reported 6-foot-11 wingspan. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
